newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.97 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.97 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills jumped to 15.97 percent at the latest weekly tender after rising to 14.99 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.233 billion rand. The average price was 96.020 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.09 percent from 15.07 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.013 billion rand. The average price was 92.475 rand percent.
